story_info.title: Max Monkey's Brave Cave Hunt
story_info.subtitle: A curious monkey's big adventure!
story_info.moral: Being brave helps you find wonderful things.

main_character.name: Max Monkey
main_character.appearance: Max is a small, energetic monkey with soft brown fur, a lighter tan face and belly, big curious eyes, and a long curling tail. He has an eager, wide-open smile.

cover.prompt: Pixar-quality 3D illustration of Max Monkey, a small, energetic monkey with soft brown fur, a lighter tan face and belly, big curious eyes, and a long curling tail. He has an eager, wide-open smile. Max is cautiously peeking into a small, dark cave entrance in a lush, green Adventure Jungle. Warm cinematic lighting, pastel colours, children's book illustration, vertical composition, Instagram friendly.
cover.setting: A sunny Adventure Jungle clearing near rocks
cover.visual_action: Max Monkey peeks into a dark cave entrance

slides.title: Max's New Day
slides.text: Max Monkey woke up. 'Adventure is waiting!' he said. He stretched his long tail. Today felt like a special day. Max wanted to explore something new. He thought of the Adventure Jungle. It was his favorite place. He packed a juicy mango. Then, Max swung off into the trees.
slides.speaker_notes: Max wakes up excited for a new adventure in his favorite place.

slides.title: A Hidden Spot
slides.text: Max jumped from vine to vine. The jungle was green and bright. He heard birds sing. Suddenly, he saw something. Hidden behind big green leaves was a small opening. It looked like a tiny door in a rock. 'Is that a cave?' Max thought. His eyes grew wide.
slides.speaker_notes: Max discovers a mysterious opening in the jungle.

slides.title: Feeling Brave
slides.text: Max walked closer to the opening. It was dark inside. A little bit dark, a little bit new. Max felt a tiny flutter in his tummy. 'What if it's too spooky?' he thought. But then he remembered. Adventures are always fun. And he was Max Monkey! He was brave.
slides.speaker_notes: Max feels a bit nervous but reminds himself to be brave.

slides.title: A Sparkling Secret
slides.text: Max took a big breath. He peeked his head inside. Wow! The cave was not spooky at all. It was small and cozy. Little shiny stones looked pretty on the walls. Max saw a pretty blue stone. He picked it up gently. It was a treasure! He explored a little more.
slides.speaker_notes: Max bravely enters the cave and finds a beautiful surprise.

slides.title: Proud Max
slides.text: Max came out of the cave. He held his blue shiny stone. A happy smile spread across his face. He felt very proud. He was brave, and he found a special secret place. The sun felt warm on his fur. Max knew he could do many brave things.
slides.speaker_notes: Max emerges from the cave, feeling happy and confident after his adventure.
